0022600148.text: The 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) are on a two-game winning streak as they visit the Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 8th in the East), who have lost their last two. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). Philadelphia won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 118-114 win in Charlotte on March 28, 2026, and the teams have not yet met this season.
